limits: Successful finite production and four-cell comparison evidence does not declare completion of CI, independent review, merge or final migration acceptance.
projection_policy: Only explicitly selected fields are copied; terminal values, case values, exit codes and hashes are never replaced.
Native command log path and native asset path are reduced to their observed basename; the original log/asset hash is retained.
Compiler and tool version values retain only observed version lines; executable paths, InstalledDir and host CPU lines are omitted.
Identical projection functions are used for linked rows, ABI objects and package objects in each run and comparison.
Snapshot byte counts and SHA-256 values are retained; machine-specific snapshot file locations are omitted.
No raw logs, wire payloads, process IDs, argv, environment, host paths, credentials or connection configuration are exported.

Prepared candidate/previous Native packages retain their existing native blocks exactly: ABI version, full capability map, engine ID, RID, CPU baseline, facade package identity/version, relative runtime asset path and native hash.
purpose: Five finite public projections of actual candidate 7 production and business-comparison summaries
